Name: Zebrus Where is my NPC
Author: Zebruu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Search villagers by name as you type. Results update instantly.

Filter by mod, current location, gender, and whether they're a marriage candidate. Filters are combinable and automatically narrow each other.

Press the "My Location" button to instantly filter to whichever location you're currently standing in.

Open a villager's detail view to see their friendship hearts (shown as heart icons, including empty and unreachable hearts based on their actual maximum), birthday, gender, marriage eligibility, source mod, and where they currently are right now.

Villagers with a birthday today are automatically pinned to the top of the results list, marked with "(Birthday)".

Villager data is read from the game's own character data, so villagers added by NPC mods are included automatically in most cases. Mod origin detection currently has specific support for Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp, with a generic fallback for other mods.

You'll receive a welcome letter from Mayor Lewis on your first day, mentioning the search hotkey.[/color]

[b]Language[/b]
English and German

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
- Zebrus Core[/color]

[b][size=4]Optional[/size][/b]
- Generic Mod Config Menu (to change the hotkey in-game)

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Multiplayer/split-screen safe. Mod origin detection (shown as "From: ...") is based on a combination of automatic detection and a maintained list of known mods; less common NPC mods may show as "Other Mod" rather than their actual name. This doesn't affect search or filtering, only the displayed source label. If your favorite NPC mod shows as "Other Mod", feel free to report it so it can be added to the list.
